description: Saves one of the business's numeric scheduling rules the solver reads on the next assignment, as Save on the staffing rules grid does: ruleKind (a buffer, an arrival window, a daily cap and the like), value in that rule's unit (minutes, a count, or 0/1 for duration_basis), optional hardness (hard: never break it; soft: avoid when possible) and a reason. The same scope and kind again updates the same rule. staffId targets one field worker (null or omitted is the whole business; a native max_jobs_per_window rule is always the business). Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: save_scheduling_rule
title: Save a staffing rule
